Our story

Ours is a love story told in little moments: stolen glances, silly inside jokes, and sweet promises whispered when no one else was listening. Somewhere along the way, a friend became a favorite person, and a favorite person became home. We learned that love isn’t just finding the right one. It’s holding each other’s hand through every season, in sunshine and in rain.

Somewhere between lazy afternoons on the grass and slow dances under the trees, our hearts found their way to each other. Every laugh, every quiet moment, every small kindness became one more reason to choose forever.

This is not the end of our story, but the beginning of our most beautiful chapter.

Walk with us

Be there as we walk down the aisle, speak our vows before God, and begin our forever together. Sharing this day with you would make it complete.
